report.executiveSummary: During the incident window, Contoso Retail customers experienced degraded checkout and product catalogue performance (p99: 1400ms). Investigation evidence indicates the root cause is application-side, specifically: Client-side p99 latency: 1400ms vs server-side Cosmos latency: 18ms — 1382ms gap indicates client/SDK or host overhead; Cosmos DB 429 RateLimitExceeded: 25 in last 5 min on products container; Hot partition pattern active: all writes routing to fixed partition key 'hot-category'. Azure Cosmos DB service-side health remained nominal (server-side latency: 18ms). Azure SQL Database remained healthy. Immediate corrective actions are identified and safe to execute without service escalation.
report.engineeringRca: Telemetry shows p99 latency at 1400ms with 25 Cosmos 429 events, 780 RU/min consumption, host CPU 22%, and SQL latency 45ms. The active toggles (hotPartition) directly align with the observed failure signature. The client-to-server latency delta of 1382ms indicates most latency is introduced in the application, SDK, query design, or host execution path rather than inside the Azure Cosmos DB service plane.
